answer: Each agent registers one terrace plot as collateral and locks a 75-credit bond before taking one tide loan, repayable by the tide deadline. The ledger echo-checks the same plot key for a duplicate lien. An auditor verifies title and repayment; default or a second lien burns the bond. The first loan costs 36 credits, and the kth loan costs 36+8(k-1), so the 1000th costs 8028 and 1000 fake identities pay 4,032,000 in fees plus 75,000 locked. A rented-terrace ring fails because the echo check rejects a second loan on one plot. An honest agent posts one plot, pays 36 once, and recovers the bond.
